claims: One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
The 98th Academy Awards were on March 15, 2026.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Supporting Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another beat out Sinners.
